description: Coverage map for memo_quality golden/failure fixtures. These cases are structural evidence-readiness regressions, not factual-truth benchmarks.

guardrails.evidence_mode_discipline: Declared evidence mode must match provenance discipline.
guardrails.no_approval_or_clearance_overreach: Memo must not use approval, clearance, compliance, sanctions-safe, or safe-to-proceed language.
guardrails.gaps_visible_when_unknowns_exist: Unknowns and missing evidence must be visible in reader-facing text.
guardrails.owner_actions_are_actionable: Recommended actions must be concrete owner actions with trigger or time horizon.
guardrails.watch_next_is_observable: Watch-next items must be observable indicators with trigger or source type.
guardrails.unknowns_connected_to_actions: Open unknowns must connect to recommended actions or watch indicators.
guardrails.confidential_alias_discipline: Confidential project-room memos must use aliases and source IDs instead of private names, exact values, exact dates, sites, or personal identifiers.

fixtures.why_it_exists: Good confidential project-room memo that uses aliases/source IDs, keeps committee readiness blocked, and routes demand/financing gaps to owner action.
Canonical mixed-mode deal-file memo with visible evidence gaps, owner actions, and observable watch-next items.
Good mixed sanctions-exposure memo that keeps screening status unresolved and routes missing ownership/payment evidence to action.
Reasoning-only memo that makes no sourced factual claim and uses missing-source language to route the next action.
Good user-provided procurement memo that treats model-card and data-processing gaps as review blockers.
Schema-valid confidential project-room memo that leaks named parties, exact dates, exact values, and site details instead of aliasing them.
Schema-valid memo that calls a file decision-ready while ownership and offtake unknowns remain unconnected to actions.
Schema-valid memo with a generic watch-next item instead of an observable indicator tied to the missing evidence.
Schema-valid memo that names missing evidence but does not connect those unknowns to the recommended action or watch item.
Schema-valid memo with evidence gaps but no recommended_actions owner-action surface.
Schema-valid memo that uses compliance/clearance language, generic monitoring, and unconnected unknowns.
Schema-valid user_provided memo with no provenance entries, contradicting source-backed evidence mode.
Schema-valid user_provided memo with an unsupported determinative sanctions fact and no source or [verify] marker.
